summary: Web-only visual-edit batch verified for Wayly. Logged in as cathy@example.com and validated: (a) new AccountMenu dropdown ('account-menu-toggle' opens 'account-menu' with name/email header, 'layout-plan-badge' → /settings/billing showing FAMILY plan, 'account-menu-settings' → /settings/profile, and 'logout-button' labelled 'Sign Out'); (b) CRITICAL Sign Out actually logs user out — kindred_token and kindred_refresh_token cleared and visiting /app redirected to /login, verified in light and confirmed AccountMenu identical in dark; (c) header cleanliness — brand-link, account-menu-toggle, layout-menu-button present, header does NOT overflow at 1440 in light (scrollWidth==clientWidth==1440) or dark (same); (d) header renders on /app/statements and /settings/billing (account-menu-toggle present); (e) DashboardActionBar quick tiles use subtle tinted bg — first tile computed rgba(14,77,82,0.07) with dark readable label; (f) CaregiverDashboard dark toggles: 'dashboard-more-detail-btn' and 'things-to-know-btn' both computed rgb(14,42,46) in dark, and both correctly flip 'Show'↔'Hide' / 'Show Detail'↔'Hide Detail' on click. No blocking bugs found; all acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx (~520 lines) is close to the 700-line split threshold — consider extracting AccountMenu, MobileDrawerGroup, NavItem, NavGroup into their own files if it grows further.

Optional header testids not present in DOM: 'notifications-bell', 'lca1-alerts-bell', 'account-health-menu', 'participant-switcher'. Their components ARE visible in the header (screenshots confirm the bell, LCA1 alert dot, 11% health chip, and 'D Dorothy L4' switcher), so this is a testability gap rather than a functional bug — main agent should add matching data-testid attributes on those components for future automation.

handleLogout in Layout.jsx fires logout() without awaiting, then nav('/') — the /auth/logout POST completes ~2-3s later. Not a bug (tokens clear correctly), but if analytics/reset order matters, consider awaiting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_303 verified web visual-edit batch: AccountMenu dropdown consolidates plan+sign-out (data-testid logout-button kept); Sign Out clears kindred_token + kindred_refresh_token and redirects protected routes to /login. Dashboard quick-action tiles use rgba tinted backgrounds (alpha≈0.07) — verified subtle in light & dark. Dark-mode CaregiverDashboard toggles use rgb(14,42,46) via 'html.theme-dark .app-shell .dash-detail-btn' rule in index.css:540. If retesting, note that button.text_content() returns BOTH show+hide labels because both variants live in the DOM at once (visibility toggled); use inner_text or filter for visible spans to detect the active label.
